sectionMetadata: server-rendered (section classes); aem.js decorateSections does not read section-metadata
trustedTypes: CSP require-trusted-types-for 'script'; scripts.js installs a 'default' policy, so innerHTML works

breakpoints.note: DESIGN.json extensions.breakpoints.target is unset, so lint:breakpoints is not wired

foundation.sectionCap: main > .section { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto } — per section, centred; blocks own their inner gutters (default content gets padding 0 5%)

buttons.accent (<strong><em><a>): red pill (uc-btn), text width; 16px/10px 21px, 18px/11.25px 23px from 1088px; modifiers .large, .round
buttons.chromeOnly: .cta--standard (header CTA links) and .cta--grey (modal Cancel) live in the header block / lazy-styles

documents./nav: default — offer/landing pages (Checking -> chooseyourchecking500tiered, Savings, CDs/IRAs)
documents./nav-deposits: deposit pages (growyoursavings, cd-ira): Checking -> 2026t3unauth + 'En español' CTA
documents./nav-debitcard: deposits/debitcard/overview: 'Manage your card' menu + Explore FAQs + 'En español' CTA
documents./nav-balanceconnect: deposits/balanceconnect: grey utility bar + tabbed menu
documents./nav-deals: en/deals: grey utility bar + two header CTA links, no menu

header.selection: page metadata `nav` (e.g. /nav-deposits); `spanish-url` re-targets the 'En español' link
header.model: sections classified by content: style `utility` = utility bar; section with <ul> = menu (style `tabs` = tabbed); first other = brand (logo link, logo image injected from /icons/bofa-logo.svg); rest = CTA links (author as plain links, not buttons)

documents./footer: grey #ededed legal bar (logo, legal links, copyright, legal code)

footer.selection: page metadata `footer`; `legal-code` replaces the per-page code line (e.g. 'MAP8880996-11062027 | LP-08-26-0253.A')
footer.disclosures: page content (the per-page footnotes), NOT the footer document — authored as the page's last section/block

modals.fragmentModal: any link whose path starts with /content/experience-fragments/ or /modals/ (same origin or promotions.bankofamerica.com) opens <path>.plain.html in dialog.site-modal
modals.fragmentContext: the fragment is decorated inside main.modal-fragment: a block can test block.closest('.modal-fragment') and render body content only (the dialog shell and close button come from the foundation)
modals.variants: a section or block class containing `wide` (750px), `center` (centred text) or `notice` (exit-notice heading) styles the dialog
modals.exitNotice: links to hosts outside bankofamerica.com / bofa.com / ml.com / merrill(edge).com / aem.page|live open /modals/exit-notice; '#continue' proceeds (new tab), '#cancel' closes

fonts.faces: styles/fonts.css (Connections 100-700 + italics, 'connections text' variable, icomoon, icomoon-interactive)
fonts.fallback: connections-fallback (Arial/Liberation Sans, width-probed: 94.88% regular, 90.55% light) in styles.css
fonts.licensing: proprietary Bank of America faces — fonts/LICENSING.md + banner in styles/styles.css

favicon: favicon.ico (repo root) fetched from the source's link[rel=icon] (/etc.clientlibs/.../favicon.ico); head.html unchanged
